_readme: Edit this file (or pass your own path to `npm run db:import -- path/to/file.json`). Field names mirror the camelCase `Property`/`Agent` types in src/lib/types.ts; the import script maps them to the snake_case DB columns. Import agents implicitly via each property's `agentId` — agents listed here are upserted first. Keep status 'draft' or 'pending_review' until a listing is cleared to go live; ONLY status 'active' is shown publicly (RLS). Listings render even with an empty `images` array (branded placeholders) — flip SHOW_REAL_MEDIA in src/lib/media.ts to true only once real photo URLs are in place.
